settings.title: Telegram
settings.description: Answer agents, get notifications and stop the team from your phone, through your own bot
settings.intro: The app talks to your own Telegram bot from this computer. There is no server of ours in between: only this computer and Telegram see the messages.

steps.title: Set it up
steps.createBot: In Telegram, open @BotFather, send /newbot and follow its steps. It gives you a token.
steps.pasteToken: Paste the token below and save it.
steps.sendStart: Send the bot the pairing command shown below (it is valid for 10 minutes).

token.label: Bot token
token.saved: A token is saved. It is not shown again; paste a new one to replace it.

status.label: Status
status.not_set: No token. The bot is off and nothing talks to Telegram.

errors.bad_token: Telegram does not accept this token. Check it in @BotFather.
errors.conflict: Another program is reading this bot's messages. Close it, or create a separate bot for this app.
errors.network: Telegram is not reachable. The app keeps trying.
errors.rate_limited: Telegram asked to slow down. The app tries again shortly.
errors.unknown: Telegram returned an error. The app keeps trying.

pairing.title: Pairing
pairing.instructions: Send this to your bot in Telegram:
pairing.needToken: Save a token first to pair.
pairing.notPaired: Not paired yet. Only the person who pairs can use the bot; everyone else is ignored.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.reviewWaiting: A task or a design waits for your review
notifications.taskFailed: A task failed, got stuck or errored

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Bot chats are not end-to-end encrypted: Telegram sees task titles, questions and summaries sent to the chat. No secrets, keys or environment values are ever sent. The bot works only while the app is open; Telegram keeps messages for 24 hours, and on start the app skips commands and button presses older than 15 minutes.

digest.title: Morning digest
digest.description: Once a day: what merged, what waits for you, what runs, what failed, and the spend. If the app is closed at that time, it comes when the app starts the same day.

bot.paired: ✅ Paired. This chat now gets Vibe Teamlead notifications. Send /help to see the commands.
bot.help: Commands /status: projects, running and queued tasks, what waits for you, today's spend /project: choose the project for later commands /task <text>: a new task in the current project (Planning) /stop_all: stop every running agent and pause the queue /resume: resume the queue /help: this list Questions Agent questions come here with buttons; tap one, or Other… to type an answer. New tasks A plain message offers to create a task from it; a long one can be analysed as a brief.
bot.unknown: I don't know that one. Send /help to see the commands.
bot.skipped: While the app was not reading the chat, I skipped what was older than 15 minutes: {{items}}. Send it again if it is still needed.

question.title: ❓ Agent asks · {{task}}
question.dismissed: The agent stopped waiting for this answer.
question.noLongerWaiting: This question no longer waits for an answer.

notify.baseBrokenDetail: A task to fix main was started.
notify.architectureReadyDetail: The diagrams and decisions are in the task's Architecture tab. Look them over in the app and mark the task done.
notify.designFailedDetail: The designer stopped. Try the design again, or build without it: here, or on the task's Design tab in the app.

status.title: 📊 Status
status.noProjects: No projects are open in the app.
status.queuePaused: ⏸ The queue is paused. /resume starts it again.

project.choose: 📁 Choose the project for later commands:
project.none: No projects are open in the app.

stopAll.confirm: 🛑 Stop every running agent and pause the queue?
stopAll.confirmCount_one: 🛑 Stop {{count}} running task and pause the queue?
stopAll.confirmCount_other: 🛑 Stop {{count}} running tasks and pause the queue?
stopAll.done_one: 🛑 Stopped {{count}} task. The queue is paused; /resume starts it again.
stopAll.done_other: 🛑 Stopped {{count}} tasks. The queue is paused; /resume starts it again.

digest.title: ☀️ Good morning. Since the last digest:
digest.quiet: Nothing new: no task merged, waits for you, runs or failed.

review.checksFromTask: {{line}} (the commands came from the task itself: the base had no checks)
review.mergeNeedsReview: ⚠️ An agent changed files to bring in the latest changes. Nothing reached the project yet: check them on the computer and confirm.
review.noLongerWaiting: This task no longer waits for review.
review.commentPrompt: ✍️ What should the team change? Reply with your instruction.

design.commentPrompt: ✍️ What should the designer change? Reply with your comment.
design.noLongerWaiting: This design no longer waits for your approval.
design.retried: 🔁 The designer starts again from where it stopped.
design.skippedHere: ⏭ The team builds without a design (your decision).
design.decisionGone: This task no longer waits for this decision.

task.usage: Send /task and what to do, for example: /task Add a dark mode to the settings page
task.chooseProject: Several projects are open. Choose one with /project first.
task.queued: ⏸ Queued: {{title}}. It starts when a slot frees (or after /resume).
task.offer: Create a task from this message?
task.longOffer: This is a long text. Create one task from it, or analyse it as a brief (epics and tasks)?

brief.analysing: 🔎 Analysing the brief. It takes a few minutes; the proposal comes here. The analyst asks no questions: open questions are listed in the proposal.
brief.busy: A brief is being analysed already. Wait for its proposal.
brief.title: 📋 Brief: {{title}} · {{project}}
